In Dobropolye (Donetsk People's Republic), units of the 51st Army, developing an pincer movement in the west and east of the city, continue to tighten the encirclement of the formations of 425th Assault Regiment of the AFU, the 4th and 15th National Guard Brigades. All the enemy's attempts to break through the encirclement and perform personnel rotation were thwarted.
▪️
Since the beginning of the enemy's encirclement in Dobropolye (Donetsk People's Republic), more than 375 militants and two pick-up trucks have been neutralised.
▪️
In total, more than 3,125 troops, 17 armoured fighting vehicles, 74 motor vehicles, seven field artillery guns, and eight electronic warfare stations have been neutralised in the Tsentr Group's area of responsibility.
🚩

📍

Strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one mountain assault brigade, one assault regiment of the AFU, and one territorial defence brigade.
▪️
Up to 220 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, 74 motor vehicles, one artillery gun, and seven electronic warfare stations were neutralised.

air defence systems shot down
37 guided aerial bombs, four U.S.-made HIMARS MLRS projectiles, four Flamingo long-range cruise missiles, and 5,031 fixed-wing UAVs.

item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29762

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
❗️
From 26 September to 2 October,
the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation carried out one massive and seven group strikes, which hit
logistics and telecommunication centres, power, transport and port infrastructure facilities used in the interests of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, military airfields, UAV manufacturing workshops and storage areas, ammunition, Flamingo ground-based cruise missiles, fuel, and military hardware depots, as well as temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed forces and foreign mercenaries.
💥
In addition,
the strikes disabled a number of facilities of the infrastructure of the Ukrainian ports,
which provided reception and storage of military cargo, as well as fuel and lubricants used in the interests of the Ukrainian Armed Forces.
🔥
During the week,
17 dry cargo ships
used to deliver Western-made weaponry, military hardware, and materiel intended to support the AFU
were hit.
▫️
Units of the Sever Group of Forces continue to tighten the encirclement around the enemy's formations in the north-east of Kharkov region and expand the external control zone.
Last week, as a result of active and resolute actions, the settlements of Petropavlovka, Lozovaya, Khripuny, Kreydyanka, Shabelnoye, Nesternoye, Rublenoye (Kharkov region) were brought under control,
and yesterday, the Russian control was established over Grachevka and Serdobino (Kharkov region). All the enemy's attempts to break through the encirclement were thwarted.
▪️
Over the past week, the enemy has lost over 265 troops, nine armoured fighting vehicles, six motor vehicles, five ATVs, and three ground robotic systems.
➡️
A total of 352 square kilometres of territory and 20 settlements have been liberated since the beginning of the AFU group's encirclement in the north-east of Kharkov region.
More than 1,085 troops, 32 armoured fighting vehicles, 19 motor vehicles, 18 ATVs, and 31 UGVs were neutralised.
🚩
In addition,
Russian elements established control over Maryino, Ulanovo, and Tolstodubovo (Sumy region), and yesterday the settlement of Malaya Rybitsa (Sumy region) was brought under Russian control. In Kharkov region, control was established over the settlement of Vysokaya Yaruga.
🔥
Also, six mechanised brigades, two motorised infantry brigades, one airmobile brigade, one unmanned systems brigade, one assault regiment, one unmanned systems regiment of the AFU, four territorial defence brigades, and one national guard brigade
were hit in Sumy and Kharkov regions.
▪️
Over the past week, in the Sever Group's area of responsibility, the enemy has lost more than 2,000 troops, 21 armoured fighting vehicles, 144 motor vehicles, four field artillery guns, two Grad MLRS combat vehicles, 11 electronic warfare stations.
↗️
During the week, units of the Zapad Group of Forces have taken more advantageous lines and positions.
Strikes were delivered at formations of four mechanised brigades, one assault brigade of the AFU, one marine brigade, one national guard brigade, and two territorial defence brigades.
▪️
The AFU losses in this direction amounted to more than 1,510 troops, 13 armoured fighting vehicles, 86 motor vehicles, nine field artillery guns, and five electronic warfare stations.
📍
Last week, units of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line.
Manpower and hardware of five mechanised brigades, one motorised infantry brigade, one assault brigade, one mountain assault brigade, two airmobile brigades, one unmanned system brigade, one assault regiment of the AFU, and two marine brigades were hit.
▪️
In total, in the Yuzhnaya Group's area of responsibility, the enemy has lost more than 1,360 troops, nine armoured fighting vehicles, 164 motor vehicles, and ten field artillery guns.
👉
See
Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🦾 Echelon of modern technologies During the Echelon 2026 exercise, units actively use ground robotic systems.
item.description: 🦾 Echelon of modern technologies During the Echelon 2026 exercise, units actively use ground robotic systems. ⚙️ The units practise delivering cargo to the line of contact using ground robotic systems and UAVs, as well as evacuating wounded servicemen and damaged vehicles. The servicemen used the Bogomol-7 ground robotic system, which delivers cargo and evacuates ATVs. 🛠 The damaged vehicles modern assembly workshop operation was organised considering the special military operation experience: hardware recovery and repair posts were deployed in underground fortifications. ▫️ The training area is protected from air attacks by observation posts and mobile firing groups. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 📥 Delivering mines right under AFU's wheels The Tsentr Group's military engineers keep giving the enemy a hard time on logistics routes
item.description: 📥 Delivering mines right under AFU's wheels 💥 The Tsentr Group's military engineers keep giving the enemy a hard time on logistics routes in Dobropolye direction. It's a piece of cake to give the enemy hell with the use of the engineer reconnaissance and mining kit. That kit also includes a drone, a UAV launcher system, as well as an additional lateral camera to control mine-planting accuracy. 💬 Ruslan Magomedov, a UAV operator, gave details about how they succeeded in thwarting the enemy's logistics routes: We were reconnoitering the forest belt, when we spotted a traffic-bound road. That means that a logistics route was layed there. We planted anti-tank mines and thwarted the logistics. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ The Armed forces of the Russian Federation continue to deliver strikes at port and power infrastructure facilities of Ukraine as well as vessels
item.description: ❗️ The Armed forces of the Russian Federation continue to deliver strikes at port and power infrastructure facilities of Ukraine as well as vessels used in the interests of the AFU. 💥 Last night, as a result of UAV strike, the following targets were hit: ▫️ in Kiev, a road-rail bridge across the Dnepr river used by the enemy to deploy his troops and to deliver military cargo intended to support the AFU's groups in the territory of Donbass; ▫️ in Kiev region, the Kievskaya electrical substation (the settlement of Nalivaykovka), which ensures the transmission of electricity and its distribution to the defence industry facilities in Kiev and Kiev region; ▫️ in Odessa region, production and industrial system in the port of Izmail, which provides reception, storage, and transportation of military cargo and fuel for the needs of the AFU. ▫️ In addition, a dry cargo ship delivering military materiel and dual-use cargo for the AFU to the port of Odessa was hit in the Black Sea. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
